name: team
description: Council-style codebase-assessment plugin. An 11-seat team across three subcommittees (research, technical, skeptics) plus a standalone legal red-flag check takes your code and produces an assessment with risks, kill criteria, and a verification plan.

interface.shortDescription: Council review for consequential code decisions
interface.longDescription: A read-only assessment council that maps a codebase, tests architectural fit, attacks assumptions, identifies legal red flags, preserves dissent, and returns a defensible technical verdict.
defaultPrompt: Assess this codebase with the full council
Map the risks, kill criteria, and verification plan
